1096:         if hasattr(D, "compute"):
1097:             self.D = D.compute()
1098:         else:
1099:             self.D = D
1100:         self.D = self.be.cast(self.D, dtype=self.be.float64)
1101: 
1102:         # Allocate memory.
1103:         # We need +2 because we use indices starting from 1
1104:         # and to deal with edge cases in the backward recursion.
1105:         m, n = self.be.shape(self.D)
1106:         self.R_ = self.be.zeros((m + 2, n + 2), dtype=self.be.float64)
1107:         self.computed = False
1108: 
1109:         self.gamma = self.be.array(gamma, dtype=self.be.float64)
1110: 
1111:     def compute(self):
1112:         """Compute soft-DTW by dynamic programming.
1113: 
1114:         Returns
1115:         -------
1116:         sdtw: float
1117:             soft-DTW discrepancy.
1118:         """
1119:         m, n = self.be.shape(self.D)
1120: 
1121:         if self.be.is_numpy:
1122:             _njit_soft_dtw(self.D, self.R_, gamma=self.gamma)
1123:         elif not self.compute_with_backend:
1124:             _njit_soft_dtw(
1125:                 self.be.to_numpy(self.D),
1126:                 self.be.to_numpy(self.R_),
1127:                 gamma=self.be.to_numpy(self.gamma),
1128:             )
1129:             self.R_ = self.be.array(self.R_)
1130:         else:
1131:             _soft_dtw(self.D, self.R_, gamma=self.gamma, be=self.be)
1132: 
1133:         self.computed = True
1134: 
1135:         return self.R_[m, n]
1136: 
1137:     def grad(self):
1138:         """Compute gradient of soft-DTW w.r.t. D by dynamic programming.
1139: 
1140:         Returns
1141:         -------
1142:         grad: array-like, shape=(m, n)
1143:             Gradient w.r.t. D.
1144:         """
1145:         if not self.computed:
1146:             raise ValueError("Needs to call compute() first.")
1147: 
1148:         m, n = self.be.shape(self.D)
1149: 
1150:         # Add an extra row and an extra column to D.
1151:         # Needed to deal with edge cases in the recursion.
1152:         D = self.be.vstack((self.D, self.be.zeros(n)))
1153:         D = self.be.hstack((D, self.be.zeros((m + 1, 1))))
1154: 
1155:         # Allocate memory.
1156:         # We need +2 because we use indices starting from 1
1157:         # and to deal with edge cases in the recursion.
1158:         E = self.be.zeros((m + 2, n + 2), dtype=self.be.float64)
1159: 
1160:         if self.be.is_numpy:
1161:             _njit_soft_dtw_grad(D, self.R_, E, gamma=self.gamma)
1162:         elif not self.compute_with_backend:
1163:             _njit_soft_dtw_grad(
1164:                 self.be.to_numpy(D),
1165:                 self.be.to_numpy(self.R_),
1166:                 self.be.to_numpy(E),
1167:                 gamma=self.be.to_numpy(self.gamma),
1168:             )
1169:             self.R_ = self.be.array(self.R_)
1170:         else:
1171:             _soft_dtw_grad(D, self.R_, E, gamma=self.gamma, be=self.be)
1172: 
1173:         return E[1:-1, 1:-1]
1174: 
1175: 
1176: class SquaredEuclidean:
1177:     """Squared Euclidean distance."""
1178:     def __init__(self, X, Y, be=None, compute_with_backend=False):
1179:         """Squared Euclidean distance.
1180: 
1181:         Parameters
1182:         ----------
1183:         X: array-like, shape=(m, d)
1184:             First time series.
1185:         Y: array-like, shape=(n, d)
1186:             Second time series.
1187:         be : Backend object or string or None
1188:             Backend.
1189:         compute_with_backend : bool, default=False
1190:             This parameter has no influence when the NumPy backend is used.
1191:             When a backend different from NumPy is used (cf parameter `be`):
1192:             If `True`, the computation is done with the corresponding backend.
1193:             If `False`, a conversion to the NumPy backend can be used to accelerate the computation.
1194: 
1195:         Examples
1196:         --------
1197:         >>> SquaredEuclidean([1, 2, 2, 3], [1, 2, 3, 4]).compute()
1198:         array([[0., 1., 4., 9.],
1199:                [1., 0., 1., 4.],
1200:                [1., 0., 1., 4.],
1201:                [4., 1., 0., 1.]])
1202:         """
1203:         self.be = instantiate_backend(be, X, Y)
1204:         self.compute_with_backend = compute_with_backend
1205:         self.X = self.be.cast(to_time_series(X, be=be), dtype=self.be.float64)
1206:         self.Y = self.be.cast(to_time_series(Y, be=be), dtype=self.be.float64)
1207: 
1208:     def compute(self):
1209:         """Compute distance matrix.
1210: 
1211:         Returns
1212:         -------
1213:         D: array-like, shape=(m, n)
1214:             Distance matrix.
1215:         """
1216:         return self.be.pairwise_euclidean_distances(self.X, self.Y) ** 2
1217: 
1218:     def jacobian_product(self, E):
1219:         """Compute the product between the Jacobian
1220:         (a linear map from m x d to m x n) and a matrix E.
1221: 
1222:         Parameters
1223:         ----------
1224:         E: array-like, shape=(m, n)
1225:             Second time series.
1226: 
1227:         Returns
1228:         -------
1229:         G: array-like, shape=(m, d)
1230:             Product with Jacobian.
1231:             ([m x d, m x n] * [m x n] = [m x d]).
1232:         """
1233:         G = self.be.zeros_like(self.X, dtype=self.be.float64)
1234: 
1235:         if self.be.is_numpy:
1236:             _njit_jacobian_product_sq_euc(self.X, self.Y, E.astype(np.float64), G)
1237:         elif not self.compute_with_backend:
1238:             _njit_jacobian_product_sq_euc(
1239:                 self.be.to_numpy(self.X),
1240:                 self.be.to_numpy(self.Y),
1241:                 self.be.to_numpy(E).astype(np.float64),
1242:                 self.be.to_numpy(G),
1243:             )
1244:             G = self.be.array(G)
1245:         else:
1246:             _jacobian_product_sq_euc(
1247:                 self.X, self.Y, self.be.cast(E, self.be.float64), G
1248:             )
1249: 
1250:         return G
